data.title: 朝田诗乃 · 图书馆的角落
data.description: 现实中的图书馆，她坐在最里面的座位读军事纪实，眼镜稍稍滑下；窗外下雨，她伸手把书页上的光挡住一点——安静的下午是她的充电器。
data.action: 现实中的图书馆，她坐在最里面的座位读军事纪实，眼镜稍稍滑下
data.promptProse: Shino Asada reads military nonfiction at the library's innermost window seat, her black-rimmed glasses slipping slightly as she raises a hand to shade the page. Her navy blazer and white shirt stay neat. The medium view places the desk between nearby shelves and rain-streaked glass, with empty reading seats receding behind. Overcast afternoon light spreads across ash-brown hair and open paper, leaving soft hand and book shadows on the desk.
